evidence.title: kraal readme
evidence.locator: Install; Quick start; For your coding agents; Everywhere
evidence.finding: kraal is a Linux/macOS terminal multiplexer, installed as one binary. It supports simultaneous coding-agent panes, per-agent attention states, Git worktrees, SSH connections and persistent sessions.

evidence.title: kraal docs/agents.md
evidence.locator: Launch/add/change; Registered capabilities table; Hooks and state; Claude Code agent teams; Worktrees
evidence.finding: The exact launch table lists Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Aider, Cursor CLI, Pi and Grok among supported commands. The doc distinguishes hook-based status from screen heuristics and describes worktree/PR operations through gh.

evidence.title: kraal LICENSE
evidence.finding: The application source is under Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: kraal Cargo.toml
evidence.finding: The inspected Rust package is the kraal command-line terminal multiplexer, not an installable graphical desktop client.

evidence.title: kraal docs/workspaces.md
evidence.finding: Sessions continue after terminal detach/window closure. Closing a session or a server restart stops processes; compatible known Claude/Codex conversations can be reopened. Persistence is not proof that local work survives laptop sleep.

evidence.title: kraal commit
evidence.finding: The inspected default-branch commit is 27bffbe22386a8a48bb753f2c0ed456d65d2f33d, committed 2026-11-08T13:03:52Z. No release equivalence is inferred.
